notes: Press reports: new unified, cloud-based Kormanyzati Adatkozpont (KAK) built in Budapest for >16 billion HUF, delivering hosting/IaaS/PaaS/SaaS for government; digitrendi.hu reported the new government datacenter completed in Budapest.
